$comment: High and critical advisories the dependency audit accepts without a fix, each with the date it was reviewed and the date it stops counting. scripts/audit-gate.cjs fails the run on any other advisory at those levels, and on one of these that outlived its expiry.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs, in picomatch <=4.0.7, which is the whole published range: there is no version to move to. Every path to it is build tooling -- Storybook and unplugin, @rollup/pluginutils, vite-plugin-pwa's globbers through tinyglobby and fdir, typescript-eslint -- and `npm audit --omit=dev` reports nothing, so no shipped code carries it. The globs come from this repository's own config, not from a user.
exceptions.revisit: Remove the entry and confirm the gate passes on its own once a picomatch release above 4.0.7 is in the tree.
